decision.criterion: at the primary eps: in_model holds iff the upper bound of the 95 % paired bootstrap CI of CVaR95(learned) - CVaR95(band) is below 0 for every seed (flat surface, as M5-06); veto(D) iff some seed has its lower bound above 0 under Heston with the reference surface and dynamics D. ADOPT iff in_model and no veto under either dynamics; REJECT iff not in_model or a veto under both; REVISE otherwise
